subject: NEUROSCI
courseName: Introduction to Communication in the Molecular Life Sciences

response.courseDescription: 201 Introduction to Communication in the Molecular Life Sciences Analysis of primary literature and an introduction to scientific communication skills in the molecular life sciences. Recommended preparation: Pre-admitted or admitted major in Biochemistry, Genetics & Cell Biology, Microbiology, or Neuroscience. (Crosslisted course offered as NEUROSCI 201, MBIOS 201.)
response.coursePrerequisites: BIOLOGY 106 with a C or better or BIOLOGY 107 with a C or better.
